metadata.gitb:name: 8.1.1. Credential Offer Endpoint
metadata.gitb:description: This endpoint is used by a credential issuer that is already interacting with a Holder who wishes to initiate a credential issuance. It is used to pass available information relevant for the credential issuance to ensure a convenient and secure process.

gitb:specification.gitb:description: A wallet holder who intends to receive credentials from an issuer should be able to get relevant information on how to obtain the credentials, so that, the process of credential issuance is convenient and secure.

preliminary.desc: A wallet has a Credential Offer Endpoint
preliminary.instruct: Your wallet must provide an endpoint for an issuer to submit a Credential Offer Object

request.desc: Provide an endpoint for credential offer
